llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed report-writing assistant that reads scoped student learning records and drafts renewal reports without sending messages or making broad account changes.

dimensions.detail: Use of workspace memory and cross-session records is proportionate for evidence-based progress reporting, with degradation guidance when platform memory/statistics are unavailable.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown-only with no executable files, install scripts, remote payload retrieval, or dependency installation behavior found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions require a specific student alias before reading, restrict reads to report-relevant workspace fields, avoid cross-student scanning, and require consent checks before parent-visible output.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill says reports do not persist, only confirmed stage evidence may be written to progressEvidence[], and it forbids sending messages, changing student status, modifying consent, or deleting full student records.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill reads sensitive longitudinal learning records for a named student and drafts stage or renewal reports; this access is purpose-aligned and explicitly disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm this skill should have access to student learning records and that the platform maps the parent-sharing consent fields correctly. It should be used only after naming one student, and parent-facing reports should remain manually reviewed and sent by the teacher.
